svg.title: Cosmic Ascendant — Weight of the Stars. Draft 4 / Cosmic Ascendant classification extension / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration).
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Celestial Alignment forks into Collapsing Star then Supernova Unbound, or Searing Starlight then Light of Dead Stars. Gravity Well forks into Event Horizon then Heart of the Singularity, or Stellar Siphon then Hunger of the Void. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Cosmic Ascendant-classified jutsu (requires classification extension).

Its only Damage row is Cosmic Explosion (50 EP at level 25, 60 AP), so burst here is exposure first: Cosmic Intent and Cosmic Chains each carry a 35% Increase Damage Taken row that lists all four stat types with no element and therefore amplifies every non-pierce hit the target takes. Decrease Damage Taken sits on three separate 40 AP jutsu (Chains 35%, Energy 35%, Aura 30%, all 2 rounds on a 7-round cooldown), which is the broadest tag in the kit and the Defensive trait's engine. Cosmic Intent is the signature A-rank cast (Increase Damage Taken 35%, Afterburn 35%, Lifesteal 40% in one 40 AP action), so its burn and its leech are offered as two rival Advanced Arts a player cannot own together."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Celestial Alignment","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagetaken","flat":2,"display_role":"ENEMY DEBUFF"},{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":2,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"}],"flavor":"When the stars fall into line, the enemy is laid bare and the ascendant burns brighter.","coverage_note":"Increase Damage Taken 35 \u2192 37% on Cosmic Intent and Cosmic Chains (enemy, 2 rounds, 40 AP); Increase Damage Given 35 \u2192 37% on Cosmic Energy (self buff at cast time).","parent_rule":"ALL","potency_classification":"Cosmic Ascendant","scope":"all Cosmic Ascendant-classified jutsu","minimum_path_bp":1,"coverage":{"jutsu":["Cosmic Chains","Cosmic Energy","Cosmic Intent"],"effect_rows":3,"rows_via_authored_classification":3}},{"id":"02","name":"Collapsing Star","category":"Hidden Art","cost":1,"parents":["01"],"modifiers":[{"tag":"damage","flat":2,"display_role":"DAMAGE"}],"flavor":"A star does not go quietly. Staggered Decrease Damage Taken casts cover six rounds in seven; overlap: Stacking risk. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
COSMIC ASCENDANT CLASSIFICATION · REQUIRES CLASSIFICATION EXTENSION
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Cosmic Ascendant-classified jutsu (requires classification extension). Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Light of Dead Stars path + Gravity Well
Heart of the Singularity path + Celestial Alignment
Hunger of the Void path + Celestial Alignment
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn · LS: Lifesteal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE COSMIC ASCENDANT KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Draft 4 / Cosmic Ascendant classification extension / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration)
